authored_basis: construction / setting-out precision of a plan; converted with the revision's own unit claim

predicates.crossing: exact intersection; end-point proximity by eps
predicates.is_horizontal: NOT USED (no axis predicate exists in the engine)
predicates.is_vertical: NOT USED (no axis predicate exists in the engine)
predicates.axis_alignment: NOT USED (no axis predicate exists in the engine)

certificate: two builds (eps_n, eps_r); a site is CERTIFIED only if identical in both
calibration: none: no room total, benchmark row or project value was read to choose any number here
source_geometry: never rewritten; clustering is topological equivalence only
frozen_at: R8.8: the numbers (2**-30 relative, 1 mm, jamb ratio 0.25) were written before the first Qortuba topology run and were never changed afterwards; this register was written after the TS01 development run on the OLD revision (K1), on which the door / glazing closure RULES were developed, and BEFORE the old-revision K2 cross-route run and the new-revision diagnostic
